decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): The cited "- service" [ev-2690c7915f58] is one entry in an ordered list. The surrounding section [ev-b07a4021f30c] makes that list concrete. It says Loki 3.0 by default automatically assigns a `service_name` label to all ingested logs. It fills that label from the first label found in this order: service_name [ev-92063a2a5bac], service, app [ev-61d6d2b50a95], and so on through job [ev-ea984d665a12]. If no listed label matches, the value is `unknown_service`. The section also says the list is configurable, and setting `discover_service_name` in limits_config to an empty value turns the feature off. This gives enough to write the assertion: the subject is the new default service_name discovery, with `service` as a source label. Exposed are streams that have no `service_name` label but do have a `service` label. Their consequence is a new `service_name` label whose value comes from `service`. The cited line is only a fragment of this larger change and may be better merged into it than treated as a change of its own.
